def __images__(self, fnm, page_from=0, page_to=100, callback=None):
        """Generate page images from PDF for cropping."""
        self.page_from = page_from
        self.page_to = page_to
        try:
            with pdfplumber.open(fnm) if isinstance(fnm, (str, PathLike)) else pdfplumber.open(BytesIO(fnm)) as pdf:
                self.pdf = pdf
                total_pages = len(pdf.pages)
                actual_page_from = max(0, min(page_from, total_pages))
                actual_page_to = max(0, min(page_to, total_pages))
                if actual_page_from >= actual_page_to:
                    self.page_images = []
                    self.logger.warning(f"No valid pages to process. page_from={page_from}, page_to={page_to}, total_pages={total_pages}")
                    return
                self.page_images = [p.to_image(resolution=72, antialias=True).original for i, p in enumerate(pdf.pages[actual_page_from:actual_page_to])]
